title: Craft Additions
description: Schema for hideout crafts missing from the tarkov.dev API, keyed by the craft id. Shaped like a tarkov.dev craft (station/level/duration/requiredItems/productItem with tarkov.dev entity ids) so consumers can merge them into the crafts list and tarkov.dev can adopt them directly.

id.description: Craft id (matches the object key; tarkov.dev/BSG recipe id).

station.description: tarkov.dev hideout station id the craft runs in.

taskUnlock.description: Id of the task that unlocks this craft (tarkov.dev task id). null on quest-gated crafts whose unlocking task id is not yet known; omit entirely when the craft has no task unlock.

requiredItems.description: Input items (attributes.tool=true marks a returned tool).

productItem.description: The item produced by the craft.
